title: fix(platform-objects): sys_email field help names no service interface; QA clause requotes the package-id refusal
body:
Part of #22093
Clause-②: no

This PR delivers remainders (b) and (c) of #22093, as the seat's partial-landing record (`6049519522`) names them. Remainder (a), the governed `submitBehavior` describe, is not in this PR and stays on the card. Wording only: no field, option, key, type or export changes. It ships a patch changeset for `@objectstack/platform-objects`. The `docs/qa` change publishes nothing.

## (b) The `sys_email` field help no longer names a service interface

Studio shows a field's `description` as its help in the object forms: the `help` leaf in each locale's `objects` bundle. Two `sys_email` fields named the `IEmailService.send` service interface there. Each one now says what the field holds and when it is set, in product words, and keeps every fact it stated before. The implementation reference moves into the code comment beside each field (`sys-email.object.ts`), in the same form PR #22125 used for the other 22 rows.

| Field | Locale | Before | After |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `headers_json` | en (source) | "Custom headers supplied to IEmailService.send, as a JSON object of name → value." | "Custom headers supplied with the message when it was sent, as a JSON object of name → value." |
| `headers_json` | zh-CN | "传给 IEmailService.send 的自定义邮件头，…" | "发送邮件时随附的自定义邮件头，…" |
| `headers_json` | ja-JP | "IEmailService.send に渡されたカスタムヘッダーを、…" | "メッセージの送信時に指定されたカスタムヘッダーを、…" |
| `headers_json` | es-ES | "Cabeceras personalizadas facilitadas a IEmailService.send, como un objeto JSON …" | "Cabeceras personalizadas facilitadas con el mensaje al enviarlo, como un objeto JSON …" |
| `status` | en (source) | "Lifecycle state — queued by IEmailService.send before transport call" | "Lifecycle state — queued when the message is submitted for sending, before the first delivery attempt" |
| `status` | zh-CN | "生命周期状态——在调用传输层之前由 IEmailService.send 排队" | "生命周期状态——邮件提交发送时即进入排队，早于首次投递尝试" |
| `status` | ja-JP | "ライフサイクル状態 — トランスポート呼び出し前に IEmailService.send がキューに入れます" | "ライフサイクル状態 — 送信が要求された時点で、最初の配信試行の前にキューに入ります" |
| `status` | es-ES | "Estado del ciclo de vida; se pone en cola mediante IEmailService.send antes de la llamada al transporte." | "Estado del ciclo de vida; queda en cola al solicitarse el envío del mensaje, antes del primer intento de entrega." |

For `headers_json`, only the first sentence changes. The rest of each leaf is unchanged. The `status` wording uses the vocabulary of the neighbouring `attempt_count` help in each locale ("delivery attempts", 投递尝试, 配信試行, intentos de entrega).

### How the bundles were produced

- **en:** regenerated by the package's documented generator, `pnpm i18n:extract`, after the source edit. It rewrote exactly the two `en` leaves.
- **zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES:** the translated leaf is itself where the translated text lives. The generator's merge mode never overwrites an existing translated leaf. The bundle header ("Edit translations in place … Do not hand-edit the structure — only the leaf string values") and AGENTS.md's Documentation Guardrails row both name re-translating the leaf in place as the maintenance path. So I re-translated the two leaves in place and then ran the generator. It wrote all 11 files and left the three translated bundles and their `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` tables byte-identical. That shows the edit changed leaf values only, never structure. Neither leaf had a recorded source hash, so no provenance entry moves. A second `pnpm i18n:extract` at the head leaves `git status` empty.
- The dispatch named es-ES and ja-JP. zh-CN carried the same phrase, so it is rewritten too.

### Pin

`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/objects-help-no-service-interface.test.ts` walks every string leaf of the four `objects` bundles. It asserts that none matches the service-interface pattern the notify Template help pin already uses (`\bI[A-Z]\w*Service\b`). It also checks the two `sys_email` source descriptions. A positive control asserts that the walk reaches both rewritten leaves in every locale, so a walk that reaches nothing cannot pass. Today no other leaf in the four bundles matches, so the pin covers the whole class for this package's object help, not just these two rows.

Ablation (one-off, no file kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the old zh-CN `status` leaf back, landing confirmed on disk (anchor 1 → 0, blob `5cf8f2e7e81d` → `64f05c216782`). The pin went red as 1 failed and 5 passed, naming `sys_email.fields.status.help` in zh-CN only. The file was restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## (c) The QA clause quotes the current package-id refusal

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`, item `cli.plugin-manifest-build-contract`, acceptance clause A2:

| Before | After |
| :--- | :--- |
| "a located Zod error ('Invalid package id '' on `manifest.id`. Expected reverse-domain notation …')" | "a located Zod error ('Invalid package id ''. A package id (`manifest.id`) is written in reverse-domain notation, like …')" |

The new quote is taken from `manifestIdRefusal` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts`) at `6729e107e`. I checked it against the live refusal: `ManifestSchema.safeParse` with `id: ''` answers on path `id` with "Invalid package id ''. A package id (`manifest.id`) is written in reverse-domain notation, like 'com.acme.crm' or 'org.example.help-desk' — …". The item's `revision` moves from 2 to 3, with one `history` entry in the file's convention (`revision`, `date`, `change`, `ref`). The scored property is unchanged, and so is A2's `verify` text: probe (d) still reads a located reverse-domain refusal that names `manifest.id` and echoes the received `''`.

## Verification (at `acc26751b`)

- **Build:** the extract closure under the verify lock, `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/lint...' --filter='@objectstack/platform-objects...' --concurrency=2`: 8 of 8 tasks, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Tests:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/apps/translations src/audit/sys-email`: 27 files, 443 tests passed.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`, all three legs including `check:test-typecheck`: exit 0.
- **Lint:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 6 changed TS files: 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population comes from `eslint.config.mjs`: `**/*.{ts,…}` minus `NEVER_LINTED`. Type-aware linting is not enabled, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 65 commands. I ran them together with the 52-row artifact-roster block, 115 unique commands. 107 exited 0.
  - Three are PR-context gates that print NOT WIRED (exit 2) without `PR_BODY` or `PR_NUMBER`. `check:partof-closing-keyword` was re-run against this body.
  - Four exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because they read a whole-workspace build this run did not make: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n` (the built CLI), `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:published-readme-exports`. For `check:i18n`, the documented command it runs for this package (`pnpm i18n:extract`) was run directly, and it is idempotent at the head.
  - `check:type-check-debt` was not run locally: its re-measure is a workspace build outside the verify lock. CI reads it.

## Acceptance notes

- The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES `headers_json` help leaves omit the last English sentence ("Never returned on the generic data path — …"). This translation lag predates this PR, and the source-hash mechanism treats a leaf with no recorded hash as legacy-trusted, so nothing flags it. This PR re-translates only the sentence that named the interface. Noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
